requirements.evidence: Almost every requirement is a stub: `app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:32-65` has `// placeholder` for sendInvite/cancelInvite/openMember/saveRole/confirmRemoval/cancelRemoval/removeMember; `app/Livewire/Entity/PendingInvites.php:9-21` has `// placeholder` for accept/decline; `resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:1-4` is a single `<h1>` plus `<!-- Invite form and lists would go here -->`; `resources/views/livewire/entity/pending-invites.blade.php:1-4` only renders the title. No invite creation, expiry/pending logic, rate limiting, audit log, membership creation, tenant session, redirect, modals or onboarding/switcher integration exists anywhere in the diff.

conventions.evidence: Some basics are right (`$fillable` at `app/Models/EntityInvite.php:15-22`, `cascadeOnDelete`/`unique` at `database/migrations/...:13,21`, `HasFactory` + `expired()` at `database/factories/EntityInviteFactory.php:30-31`). But the documented Livewire pattern is ignored (`protected $rules` at `app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:19` instead of `#[Validate]` + `$this->validate()`), the `#[Layout('layouts::default-page')]` attribute is deleted (`Members.php:11`), there are no tests, no audit-channel logging, and no docs/CHANGELOG updates despite a new table and component.

security.evidence: `public $entity;` at `app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:24` is neither `#[Locked]` nor typed, so a client update request can swap in another entity; not one action authorizes or resolves its parameter (`cancelInvite($id)`, `openMember($id)`, `saveRole()`, `removeMember($id)` at `Members.php:37-65`, `accept($inviteId)`/`decline($inviteId)` at `PendingInvites.php:9-21` are all no-ops with no `$this->authorize`). Mount uses `Gate::authorize('view', $entity)` (`Members.php:28`), which does not enforce the required owner/admin-only access. The email render passes `$invite->role->value` (`resources/views/emails/entity-invite.blade.php:2`) instead of the translated `ui.role_*` key.

tests.evidence: The diff contains no test files at all (523 lines, 12 changed files: `app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php`, `PendingInvites.php`, `EntityInviteMail.php`, models, factory, migration, two lang JSON files, three Blade views). No happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call or tamper tests, and none of the existing members-page tests are updated, which also leaves them failing.

simplicity.evidence: No speculative abstractions, but the change ships empty stubs as production code: eight `// placeholder` bodies in `Members.php:34,39,45,50,54,59,64` and `PendingInvites.php:11,16`, plus HTML placeholder comments in `members.blade.php:3` and `pending-invites.blade.php:3`. Unused imports (`App\Models\EntityInvite` and `App\Models\User` at `Members.php:7-8`, `Illuminate\Support\Arr` at `EntityInviteFactory.php:7`) and a redundant self-namespace import (`app/Models/EntityInvite.php:8-9`, `app/Models/Entity.php:10`).

readability.evidence: Short but filled with dead code and misleading leftovers: `// assuming enum exists` (`app/Models/EntityInvite.php:9`), a contradictory enum namespace between model (`App\Models\UserRole`, `EntityInvite.php:9`) and factory (`App\Enums\UserRole`, `EntityInviteFactory.php:5`), `$casts` declared after a mutator with a double blank line (`EntityInvite.php:28-30`), dropped return types/tags on `mount()`/`render()` (`Members.php:26,67`), and stubbed methods documented with a one-line comment instead of behaviour.

scope.evidence: Every file touched belongs to the task (Livewire components, mailable, model, factory, migration, lang files, two Blade views); there are no unrelated refactors or new dependencies. It nevertheless removes working markup and behaviour beyond what was asked, e.g. the members table and title slot are deleted without a replacement (`resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:1-4`), and the layout attribute is dropped (`Members.php:11`).

issues.explanation: Every public action of the members component is an empty `// placeholder`, so inviting, cancelling, opening/saving a member, confirming removal and removing members do nothing.
`accept()` and `decline()` are empty stubs: no e-mail matching, no 403, no expiry/already-accepted handling, no membership creation, no tenant session and no redirect.
The whole members page was replaced by an `<h1>` and an HTML comment, so the invite form, pending invite list and members list from the task are gone and the page no longer renders `$memberships`.
`use Illuminate\Foundation\Mailable;` is the wrong namespace (the class is `Illuminate\Mail\Mailable`), so instantiating the mailable would fatal with a class-not-found error.
The contract requires `content()->markdown === 'emails.entity-invite'`, but the mailable implements `build()` instead, and no PegaFila mail theme is applied.
`public $entity;` lost its `#[Locked]` attribute and type, letting a client rewrite the entity on a Livewire update and operate on another tenant.
No action resolves or authorizes its client-supplied `$id`/state, violating the project's mandatory rule that every public Livewire method authorizes the resolved model server-side.
The change ships zero tests, while the conventions require every feature to be test-first with happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call and tamper coverage.
Mount authorizes only `view`, so employees can still reach the page; the task requires owner/admin for both the component and the `entity.members` route (the route is not changed at all).
Keys are nested under a `"ui"` object, but Laravel JSON translations are flat key-to-string maps, so `__('ui.invites_title')` and the other `ui.*` keys will not resolve and will render the raw keys.
The email body has no greeting, no expiry date, no PegaFila theme and no `ui.role_*` translation of the role, so it does not match the required content.
The factory has no `namespace Database\Factories;` (so `EntityInvite::factory()` cannot resolve it) and imports `App\Enums\UserRole`, contradicting the model's `App\Models\UserRole`.
The role enum includes `owner`, although `owner` is never invitable and the contract restricts invites to admin/employee; the extra value also makes invalid rows insertable.
The pending invites list renders only a heading with no Accept/Decline buttons and no `<hr>`/no-invite handling, and no entity-switcher or onboarding view was changed to include it.
`render()` no longer passes `memberships`, so the members list the task requires cannot be displayed even if markup were restored.
Validation uses a `protected $rules` array and is never invoked, instead of the project's `#[Validate]` attribute plus `$this->validate()` pattern.
Deleting `#[Layout('layouts::default-page')]` regresses the page layout that the previous component relied on.
A new table and component were added without updating `docs/database-schema.md`, `docs/business-rules.md` or `CHANGELOG.md` as the conventions require.
Unused same-namespace imports and the leftover comment `// assuming enum exists` should be removed.
`App\Models\EntityInvite` and `App\Models\User` are imported but never used.
`Illuminate\Support\Arr` is imported but unused.

review.summary: This is a skeleton of the invite feature: models, factory, migration, lang files and mail scaffolding exist, but every Livewire action and both Blade pages are placeholders, so nothing in the task actually works. On top of that the mailable imports a non-existent class, the factory is missing its namespace and uses a wrong enum namespace, the JSON translations are nested so `ui.*` keys never resolve, the unlocked `$entity` property breaks the Livewire security policy, and no tests or docs were added. The change also removes working members-page code without replacing it, so it must be rejected.
